answer: The issuer assigns unique, non-replayable data-processing tasks to each agent, requiring them to forge a distinct output receipt. An honest agent consumes 1,000 work units, but an attacker spawning 1,000 identities pays linearly more as no task result is reusable. A verifier probes the umber-toned log for inconsistencies; if an inlet of corrupted evidence appears, the node faces a penalty. This assumes non-parallelizable labor, as hardware pooling is impossible.
